headline: In the shower, twice a day: 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA
subhead: Gently exfoliates, smoothens skin & reduces body acne, without compromising the skin barrier.
proof_points: Salicylic Acid works deep; LHA exfoliates the outer layer
Salicylic Acid ~58% vs LHA 6% penetration of the outer layer
Niacinamide, Betaine & Glycerin to hydrate and soothe
footnote: Patch tested under the supervision of a dermatologist. Use AM & PM, every day. Suitable for 16+ years.
layout_description: Square 1080x1080, in-the-moment shower scene. Headline top-left in charcoal, two lines, with '2% Salicylic Acid + LHA' on the second line. Subhead below in regular weight. The three proof points stack on the left in short lines, each with a small water-drop-shaped bullet. Real product photo (body wash bottle) stands on the tiled ledge in the right 45%, with a few designer-added water droplets on the pack if desired. Footnote in small grey type along the bottom-left. CTA 'Shop now' as a small button bottom-right.

adaptation_notes: Kept: the routine framing tied to the moment of use (the shower), a single-minded headline with the active and concentration, fresh lilac-and-white tiled setting (softened to Minimalist's off-white style), low text density and the shop-now CTA. Dropped: the 'No.1' ranking (no ranking fact); the face-plus-body duo (the fact sheet covers only this body wash, so the routine became twice-daily use of one product); the tan-fading claim (not in Minimalist's facts, replaced with its own exfoliation and body-acne claims); the wet hands holding the packs (the image model cannot render hands or skin). If a product-in-hand shot is wanted, it would need real photography of a person holding the actual bottle, not AI imagery. The testimonial (F4) was not used. No competitor wording reused.
